description: Ansible, Molecule, Taskfile, changelog, and Ansible collection release skills.

queries.query: Review roles/nginx/tasks/main.yml for Ansible best practices: FQCN, idempotency, no_log on secrets.
This playbook uses the shell module for everything and isn't idempotent. Refactor it the Ansible way.
How should I name variables in an Ansible role so they don't collide with other roles?
Write a Molecule scenario for the postgres role that tests on Ubuntu and Rocky Linux.
Our verify.yml only checks that files exist. Strengthen the Molecule assertions so they test real outcomes.
The Molecule idempotence check keeps failing on the users role. How do I debug it?
Review our Taskfile.yml: tasks repeat the same env vars, nothing uses sources/generates, and one task echoes a secret.
Write a Taskfile.yaml for this Go project with build, test, lint, and release tasks.
How do I make a go-task task skip when its inputs haven't changed?
Write the CHANGELOG entry for v2.3.0 from the commits since v2.2.0, in Keep a Changelog style.
Which of these commits are user-facing enough to go in the changelog?
Add an antsibull-changelog fragment for the bugfix I just made to the collection. We're not releasing yet.
Cut a new release of our Ansible collection: bump galaxy.yml, write the changelog fragment, and run the release task.
The release PR for the collection merged. Finish the release and check that Galaxy published it.
Write a Dockerfile for this Python app.
Explain what Ansible is in two sentences.
Write a Makefile with build and test targets.
Write a Terraform module for an S3 bucket.
Write a commit message for my staged changes.
Set up a Kubernetes CronJob that runs every night.
